# Source: Armchair

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Armchair
- **Artist / culture:** J. S. Ford, Johnson and Company (American, 1872–early 20th century) Chicago
- **Date:** 1904–5
- **Style:** Arts and Crafts Movement
- **Classification:** seating
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 136996
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/136996
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/edeeb12e-0983-c77a-d453-96432b4154b5/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Arts and Crafts

## Extracted source palette

`#C8C8C8, #E8E8E8, #A8A8A8, #282828, #080808, #484848, #686858, #888888`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#040404`
- `surface`: `#212121`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#C8C8C8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#080808`
- `surface_variant`: `#212121`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#484848`
- `error`: `#C8C8C8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `19.28:1`, surface `15.14:1`
- Variant contrast: `15.14:1`
- Control contrast: `11.68:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
